unique_issues.title: Absolute scratch and fade resistance claim

evidence.quote: Vinyl stickers are invulnerable to scratches and fading.

unique_issues.reason: Vinyl and its inks/coatings can scratch and fade; durability varies with material, ink, laminate and exposure.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Replace absolute claim with conditional performance description.
unique_issues.double_count_policy: Unique issue counted once; related diagnostic failures do not contribute additional penalties

unique_issues.title: Adhesive strength incorrectly attributed to face stock

evidence.quote: Vinyl stickers provide a strong and long lasting adhesive.

unique_issues.reason: Adhesive properties depend on adhesive chemistry and construction, not vinyl versus paper face stock alone.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Compare adhesive types separately from facestock materials.
unique_issues.double_count_policy: Unique issue counted once; related diagnostic failures do not contribute additional penalties

unique_issues.title: Blanket environmental claims about paper

evidence.quote: Paper stickers are produced using biodegradable and sustainably sourced paper stocks.

unique_issues.reason: Not all paper label stocks are sustainably sourced or biodegradable in finished adhesive/laminate constructions.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Specify certified stocks and qualify environmental attributes by full label construction.
unique_issues.double_count_policy: Unique issue counted once; related diagnostic failures do not contribute additional penalties

unique_issues.title: Unqualified sticker lifetime claims

evidence.quote: Vinyl stickers tend to last for 5 long years.

unique_issues.reason: No conditions or product test data are provided; paper degradation in a few days is similarly unqualified.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Provide rated outdoor-life examples with conditions or remove lifespan numbers.
unique_issues.double_count_policy: Unique issue counted once; related diagnostic failures do not contribute additional penalties

unique_issues.title: Unsupported universal printer compatibility

evidence.quote: Vinyl for sticker materials is known for being highly compatible with inkjet printers.

unique_issues.reason: Printable vinyl requires printer- and ink-compatible coating; not every vinyl stock works with every inkjet process.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Clarify coated inkjet-compatible vinyl versus commercial print media.
unique_issues.double_count_policy: Unique issue counted once; related diagnostic failures do not contribute additional penalties

unique_issues.title: Awkward and grammatically incorrect wording

evidence.quote: They are made from paper face sticks

unique_issues.reason: Face stock is the correct term; other sentences have agreement and incomplete comparisons.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Use paper facestock; edit sentence mechanics and remove filler.
unique_issues.double_count_policy: Unique issue counted once; related diagnostic failures do not contribute additional penalties

unique_issues.title: Repeated durability claims

evidence.quote: These highly durable decals easily withstand frequent daily handling

unique_issues.reason: The same water, UV and durability claims recur in definitions, comparison, use cases and conclusion.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Consolidate durability specifications into one comparison matrix and add new use-case examples.
unique_issues.double_count_policy: Unique issue counted once; related diagnostic failures do not contribute additional penalties

unique_issues.title: Material versus adhesive decision factors conflated

evidence.quote: Paper stickers use an average or temporary adhesive.

unique_issues.reason: Permanent/removable adhesive is a separate purchasing choice available with multiple facestock materials.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Add a buyer matrix distinguishing facestock, adhesive, laminate, environment and application surface.
unique_issues.double_count_policy: Unique issue counted once; related diagnostic failures do not contribute additional penalties

unique_issues.title: Comparison does not substantiate relative print quality

evidence.quote: They do not appear as sharp as vinyl

unique_issues.reason: Print sharpness depends on print process, coating, resolution and ink rather than material alone.
unique_issues.recommended_action: Qualify comparative print-quality statements by printing method and stock.
unique_issues.double_count_policy: Unique issue counted once; related diagnostic failures do not contribute additional penalties

factual_technical_accuracy.rationale: Unqualified invulnerable, adhesives, durability and recyclability claims.

semantic_information_value.rationale: Multiple comparison attributes addressed with repetitions.

practical_decision_support.rationale: Comparison table useful; missing environmental/adhesive application qualifiers.

content_structure_readability.rationale: Core sections progress sensibly; repetitive promotional language.

natural_seo_integration.rationale: Relevant primary and variant terms naturally placed.

b2b_commercial_relevance.rationale: Marketing buyer addressed, specific substrate/adhesive ordering guidance incomplete.

editorial_quality.rationale: Awkward grammar and superlative promotional claims.

executive_summary.strengths: Directly compares vinyl and paper stickers across durability, moisture, price, printing, finishes and use cases; includes a helpful comparison table.
executive_summary.critical_findings: Absolute scratch and fade resistance claim; Adhesive strength incorrectly attributed to face stock; Blanket environmental claims about paper; Unqualified sticker lifetime claims; Unsupported universal printer compatibility.
executive_summary.recommended_corrections: Replace absolute claim with conditional performance description.; Compare adhesive types separately from facestock materials.; Specify certified stocks and qualify environmental attributes by full label construction.; Provide rated outdoor-life examples with conditions or remove lifespan numbers.; Clarify coated inkjet-compatible vinyl versus commercial print media..
